label: 剧情弱引导_V03靠近怪群_靠近就开战
js: const tp = (x, y) => { const all = [t.leader, ...t.followers]; all.forEach((a, i) => { a.x = x - i * 90; a.y = y; a.node.setPosition(a.x, a.y, 0); }); t.trail = [new cc.Vec2(x - 400, y), new cc.Vec2(x, y)]; t.applyCamera(true); }; const tipNode = (name) => { const layer = root.node.getChildByName('LobbyWeakTipLayer'); return layer ? layer.getChildByName(name) : null; }; refresh(); const seen0 = root.guideTips.seen('camp_engage'); const c = t.def.camps.filter(x => !x.elite && !x.dummy).sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - t.leader.x, a.y - t.leader.y) - Math.hypot(b.x - t.leader.x, b.y - t.leader.y))[0]; window.__camp = c.stageCode; tp(c.x - c.radius - 900, c.y); await sleep(2600); const mine = () => t.monsters.filter(m => m.camp.stageCode === c.stageCode && !m.dead); for (let i = 0; i < 30 && !tipNode('FieldTipEngage'); i++) { const m = mine().sort((a, b) => a.x - b.x)[0]; if (m) { const d = Math.hypot(m.x - t.leader.x, m.y - t.leader.y); if (d > 560 || d < 300) tp(m.x - 480, m.y); } await sleep(400); } refresh(); let pulse = false; mine().forEach(m => { if (m.node.getChildByName('GuideEngagePulse')) pulse = true; }); return JSON.stringify({ seen0, camp: c.stageCode, alive: mine().length, tip: !!tipNode('FieldTipEngage'), pulse, seen: root.guideTips.seen('camp_engage'), inCombat: t.inCombat, text: texts(400).filter(s => s.indexOf('开战') >= 0) });

label: 剧情弱引导_V03第一次掉落_自动拾取
js: const tp = (x, y) => { const all = [t.leader, ...t.followers]; all.forEach((a, i) => { a.x = x - i * 90; a.y = y; a.node.setPosition(a.x, a.y, 0); }); t.trail = [new cc.Vec2(x - 400, y), new cc.Vec2(x, y)]; t.applyCamera(true); }; const tipNode = (name) => { const layer = root.node.getChildByName('LobbyWeakTipLayer'); return layer ? layer.getChildByName(name) : null; }; refresh(); clearInterval(window.__lcKeepAlive); window.__lcKeepAlive = setInterval(() => { try { const tt = window.__root.lobbyTownRenderer; tt.leaderHp = tt.leaderMaxHp || 99999; tt.followers.forEach(a => { a.hp = a.maxHp || 99999; a.down = false; }); } catch (e) {} }, 80); const mine = () => t.monsters.filter(m => m.camp.stageCode === window.__camp && !m.dead); let n = 0; for (let i = 0; i < 300 && !tipNode('FieldTipLoot') && mine().length > 0; i++) { const m = mine()[0]; if (Math.hypot(t.leader.x - m.x, t.leader.y - m.y) > 260) tp(m.x - 110, m.y); t.skillReadyAt = [0, 0, 0]; t.actionUntil = 0; if (i % 5 === 4) t.leaderSkill(n++ % 3); else t.leaderAttack(); await sleep(220); } for (let i = 0; i < 20 && !tipNode('FieldTipLoot'); i++) await sleep(300); refresh(); clearInterval(window.__lcKeepAlive); return JSON.stringify({ tip: !!tipNode('FieldTipLoot'), ring: !!find('WeakTipRing'), haul: !!t.haulNode, seen: root.guideTips.seen('loot_auto'), left: mine().length, text: texts(400).filter(s => s.indexOf('自动拾取') >= 0) });

label: 剧情弱引导_V09巨熊读条红圈
js: const tp = (x, y) => { const all = [t.leader, ...t.followers]; all.forEach((a, i) => { a.x = x - i * 90; a.y = y; a.node.setPosition(a.x, a.y, 0); }); t.trail = [new cc.Vec2(x - 400, y), new cc.Vec2(x, y)]; t.applyCamera(true); }; const tipNode = (name) => { const layer = root.node.getChildByName('LobbyWeakTipLayer'); return layer ? layer.getChildByName(name) : null; }; refresh(); t.leaderHp = t.leaderMaxHp; const c = t.def.camps.find(x => x.stageCode === 'FIELD_WOODS_E'); window.__hurts = []; if (!t.__hurtWrapped) { const h = t.hurtActor.bind(t); t.hurtActor = (a, amt) => { window.__hurts.push({ leader: a === t.leader, amt, at: Date.now() }); return h(a, amt); }; t.__hurtWrapped = true; } clearInterval(window.__lcKeepAlive); window.__lcKeepAlive = setInterval(() => { try { const tt = window.__root.lobbyTownRenderer; if (tt.leaderHp < tt.leaderMaxHp * 0.7) tt.leaderHp = tt.leaderMaxHp; tt.followers.forEach(a => { if (a.hp < a.maxHp * 0.5) a.hp = a.maxHp; a.down = false; }); } catch (e) {} }, 80); tp(c.x - 700, c.y); await sleep(2600); const bear = () => t.monsters.find(m => m.camp.stageCode === 'FIELD_WOODS_E' && !m.dead); let b = bear(); if (b) tp(b.x - 150, b.y); let casting = false; for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) { await sleep(200); b = bear(); if (b && Math.hypot(b.x - t.leader.x, b.y - t.leader.y) > 200) tp(b.x - 150, b.y); if (b && b.castUntil > 0) { casting = true; break; } } await sleep(500); refresh(); const zone = t.groundRoot.getChildByName('SlamZone_FIELD_WOODS_E'); return JSON.stringify({ bear: !!b, casting, zone: !!zone, tip: !!tipNode('FieldTipBossCast'), seen: root.guideTips.seen('boss_cast'), text: texts(400).filter(s => s.indexOf('红圈') >= 0 || s.indexOf('蓄力') >= 0) });
